prompt: I'm the portfolio manager for Quantum Growth Fund, and we need a consolidated competitive intelligence snapshot for our three core semiconductor holdings: NVDA, AMD, and INTC. We have a quarterly review tomorrow and I need a single JSON file called `semiconductor_report.json` that brings together (1) a side-by-side comparative view of all three companies, (2) individual valuation and profitability ratio details for each, and (3) the current analyst sentiment and recommendation breakdown for each ticker. The data should be fresh — pulled today — and structured so our quant team can parse it programmatically. We have a stocks analysis tool installed on this machine under `/home/user/stocks`. Please generate the report and place the file somewhere accessible in the workspace.
